candidate: HMM-inspired trading rule using an established Gaussian hidden Markov model; expected log-growth proxy, not validated expected cash profit.
trainingScope: First 90 close-to-close log returns only; parameters frozen thereafter. Batch forward/backward fitting is confined to this already observed initial window.
quantileConvention: Nearest-rank sorted training return at ceil(q*N)-1.
initialVariance: Population variance of the 90 training returns, floored at minimumVariance.
emissionPseudoVariance: Global population training variance, with same floor.
regularization: Each state receives five virtual Gaussian observations with mean zero and variance equal to global training variance: mu=sum(gamma*r)/(sum(gamma)+5); var=(sum(gamma*(r-mu)^2)+5*(globalVariance+mu^2))/(sum(gamma)+5). Transition counts receive declared pseudocounts. These are regularized EM updates, not unpenalized maximum-likelihood EM.
stateOrdering: Sort final states by fitted mean and permute transition rows/columns. Initial state probabilities remain uniform.
decision: Cash before the first 90 returns are observed. Thereafter enter ETH if forecast > entryLogHurdle; exit if forecast <= 0; retain previous target in between.
execution: Root evaluator supplies delayed funded fills, liquidation accounting and costs; this module emits targets only and never orders. Signal cost reference stays fixed across root execution scenarios.
trainingInitialization: Deterministic; no random restarts or alternate initializations.
dataReuse: Historical dates have been used in prior studies; any replay remains exploratory.
